english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#14
english_title: Proposition 3.2: Basic Properties of the Limit Superior and Limit Inferior of a Function
statement_en:
Let $U:=\limsup_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$ and $L:=\liminf_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$. Then:
1. There exist sequences $x_n,y_n\to +\infty$ such that $f(x_n)\to U$ and $f(y_n)\to L$.
2. For every $r>U$, there exists $R_0$ such that for all $x\geq R_0$, one has $f(x)<r$. For every $r<U$ and every $R$, there exists $x\geq R$ such that $f(x)>r$.
3. For every $r<L$, there exists $R_0$ such that for all $x\geq R_0$, one has $f(x)>r$. For every $r>L$ and every $R$, there exists $x\geq R$ such that $f(x)<r$.
key_techniques: tail supremum and infimum for functions
prerequisites: limit superior and limit inferior of functions
callout_body:
令$U:=\limsup_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$以及$L:=\liminf_{x\to +\infty}f(x)$那么:
1. 存在序列$x_n,y_n\to +\infty$满足$f(x_n)\to U$以及$f(y_n)\to L$。
2. 对任意$r>U$存在一个$R_0$使得任意$x\geq R_0$都有$f(x)<r$。对任意$r<U$任意$R$都存在$x\geq R$使得$f(x)>r$。
3. 对任意$r<L$存在一个$R_0$使得任意$x\geq R_0$都有$f(x)>r$。对任意$r>L$任意$R$都存在$x\geq R$使得$f(x)<r$。
